main_text.p: Sic ἐφίλησα, ἐφίλευσα, ἐφίλησα: at ἐδηκα, ἔδωκα, pro ἔδην, ἔδω: quæ duo postrema deinceps inusitata.
Prima syllaba primi & secundi aoristi, est prima præteriti infecti: in reliquis aoristis nullum est incrementum.
Ultima & penultima est eadem quæ primi futuri infecti: ultima, vertit ω in α: ut πμήσω, ἐτίμησα.
Anomalia figurativa. 1. Sequentia duo retinent figurativam præsentis: ut οἴνεγκα, οἰνέγξω, ἠνεγκα, fero, feram, tuli: εἶπω, εἴπον, εἶπα, dico, dicebam, dixi.
σθλίω, σθλίσω, ἔσθλα, agito, concito: Doricé ἔσθλα.

page.notes: Greek words are printed with heavy accents and partly damaged; accents and some letters are uncertain and may be misread. The foot mark "m ÿ" is a signature-like printer's mark and is not transcribed as text.
